description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery estimates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Email complaining about webshops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialDelivery" name="First delivery batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Reorder from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Reorder from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDelivery" name="Further delivery batches"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_StartLaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, price and delivery estimates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Compare offers and allocate parts to the cheapest shops where needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive the first parts batch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Batches arrive in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Build" name="Build project and manage stock">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Build" name="First parts batch received"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build project"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Build" name="Project building complete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Start" sourceRef="Start_Build" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="End_Build"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Receive further delivery batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartLaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndLaterBatch" name="Batch added to stock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_Add" sourceRef="Event_StartLaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_End" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="Event_EndLaterBatch"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_BelowFive" name="Reorder when stock falls below five" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartBelowFive" name="A part's stock falls below five" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_BelowFive">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 5</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndBelowFive" name="Cheapest-shop reorder sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Reorder" sourceRef="Event_StartBelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Event_EndBelowFive"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_BelowThree" name="Reorder when stock falls below three" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartBelowThree" name="A part's stock falls below three" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_BelowThree">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 3</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndBelowThree" name="Fastest-shop reorder sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Reorder" sourceRef="Event_StartBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Event_EndBelowThree"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_ZeroStock" name="Complain when stock reaches zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartZeroStock" name="A part's stock reaches zero" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ZeroStock">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part = 0</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the webshops"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndZeroStock" name="Complaint email sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_Email" sourceRef="Event_StartZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Event_EndZeroStock"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract project complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Lists" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="SubProcess_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_ContractEnd" sourceRef="SubProcess_Build" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
